harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: a wait carried by a guarded instruction (kind gw): a scoreboarded producer (SHFL.BFLY or a shared load) on a write barrier, the ONLY wait on that barrier on an instruction under the guard @P4 two cycles behind the producer, the reader an instruction under the opposite guard @!P4 with no wait of its own, d issue cycles behind the producer; P4 is false in part of the iterations (a bit of the iteration counter) or in every iteration; without and with the yield flag; every request has its twin without any wait - the positive control (that control never waits the barrier at all: it is not a floor by distance) - on a Workstation Edition card, the probe alone

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

provenance.dep_table_commit: 455817a tools/stallfloor/probe.py 25, second part: five cells of the dependency table on their measured floor; the hold

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
